vocabulary.definition: the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region
vocabulary.example: In the rural area, they speak a vernacular that is different from the standard national language.

vocabulary.definition: abrupt or offhand in speech or manner
vocabulary.example: His brusque response left her feeling offended and dismissed.

vocabulary.definition: casual or friendly conversation about unimportant matters
vocabulary.example: Before the meeting, they engaged in some chit-chat about the upcoming weekend.

vocabulary.definition: a person or thing that takes an active role or produces a specified effect
vocabulary.example: In the play, the detective acted as an agent of justice, solving the crime.

vocabulary.definition: expressed concisely and directly; without unnecessary details
vocabulary.example: Her presentation was clear, concise, and always to the point.

vocabulary.definition: until now; until this moment in time
vocabulary.example: Up to this point, I have not received any feedback on my proposal.
